findings.evidence: Normalizer.lean:209,217-218,237; the repo already states exactly this factored form for the unconnected case: `PermutationTriple.equivalent_iff_exists_smul_eq` (Basic.lean:283-286), proved by the same `orbitRel_apply`/`mem_orbit_iff` chain. Mathlib: `orbitRel_apply : orbitRel G α a b ↔ a ∈ orbit G b` (GroupAction/Defs.lean:294), `mem_orbit_iff : a₂ ∈ orbit γ a₁ ↔ ∃ x, x • a₁ = a₂` (Defs.lean:55).
findings.fix: Add `ConnectedIsoClass.mk_eq_mk_iff_exists_smul {t t' : ConnectedTriple n} : mk t = mk t' ↔ ∃ τ : Perm (Fin n), τ • t' = t` in `Passport/Basic.lean` next to `mk_eq_mk_iff`, and rewrite with it at all four sites.
findings.issue: The chain `rw [ConnectedIsoClass.mk_eq_mk_iff, orbitRel_apply, mem_orbit_iff]` is repeated at lines 209, 217-218 (twice in one rw) and 237 to turn class equality into `∃ τ, τ • _ = _`. This hides a reusable fact and repeats a Mathlib-named chain in four places.

findings.evidence: Line 210 goal reduces to `(τ : Perm) • (g.toConnectedTriple hn hG).1 = ((τ • g).toConnectedTriple hn hG).1`, which needs `toConnectedTriple` (line 177) unfolded on both sides; same at line 238 for `(⟨τ • s.1, hτ⟩).toConnectedTriple hn hG`. `toConnectedTriple` is not `@[expose]`d, the pattern `QuotientGroup.congrOfSurjectiveOfKerLe_mk` in TauCeti/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:398-405 documents at length.
findings.fix: Use `Subtype.ext (by simp)` at both sites so the proofs go through `coe_toConnectedTriple`/`coe_smul`, or add a comment stating why the defeq is relied on.
findings.issue: `exact ⟨(τ : Perm (Fin n)), Subtype.ext (rfl)⟩` (line 210) and `exact ⟨τ, Subtype.ext (rfl)⟩` (line 238) close by unfolding the body of the non-reducible `def toConnectedTriple` plus both `SMul` instances, with no comment. The file declares `coe_toConnectedTriple` (line 182) and `GeneratingTriple.coe_smul` (line 162) as `@[simp]` precisely to be that interface, and they are unused here.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but the same three-lemma quotient-unfolding chain is repeated four times instead of being factored into the reusable lemma the repo already has an analogue of, and two proofs close by `rfl` through the body of `toConnectedTriple` rather than the `@[simp]` coe lemmas declared for that purpose.
